channel.title: Simple Skillet Recipes
channel.description: Tested weeknight recipes by Simple Skillet

item.title: Maryland Crab Stuffed Flounder Recipe
item.description: Master Maryland crab stuffed flounder with the perfect 3:1 stuffing-to-fish ratio and baking times for flaky, buttery fish and jumbo lump crab.

item.title: Roasted Tomato Blender Marinara Recipe
item.description: Make this easy roasted tomato blender marinara with no added sugar. A low carb, rich, and rustic homemade pasta sauce roasted on a sheet pan and blended.

item.title: Lasagna Without Ricotta or Cottage Cheese
item.description: Make a rich, traditional lasagna without ricotta or cottage cheese. This recipe uses a velvety, homemade bechamel sauce for the ultimate creamy texture.

item.title: No-Fuss Sourdough Bread Unfed Starter Recipe
item.description: Bake a rustic loaf of sourdough bread using unfed starter. Learn the timing, texture tradeoffs, and how to get a great rise without feeding your culture.

item.title: Hibachi Steak and Chicken at Home Recipe
item.description: Recreate the classic Japanese steakhouse experience with this easy hibachi steak and chicken at home, complete with fried rice and yum yum sauce.

item.title: Baked Chicken Meatballs Vodka Sauce
item.description: Tender baked chicken meatballs tossed in rich vodka sauce and rigatoni. A cozy, lightened-up 40-minute weeknight dinner made in a single skillet.

item.title: One-Pot Creamy Beef Pasta Bake
item.description: Make this creamy beef pasta bake in just one skillet. A high-protein, 40-minute weeknight dinner with minimal cleanup and maximum flavor.

item.title: Pan Fried Chicken Tenders No Breading (7 Mins)
item.description: Learn how to make juicy pan fried chicken tenders no breading in just 7 minutes. A quick, low-carb, and gluten-free weeknight dinner recipe.

item.title: Healthy Chicken Pot Pie (Lightened-Up)
item.description: Enjoy a comforting, healthy chicken pot pie with a flaky, lightened-up crust. Packed with vegetables and a creamy, low-fat herb sauce.

item.title: Easy Pot Roast Slow Cooker Recipe
item.description: Make a tender, juicy beef dinner with this easy pot roast slow cooker recipe. Features onion soup mix for rich flavor, plus oven instructions.

item.title: Crispy Oven Baked Chicken Cutlets (Italian-Style)
item.description: Master the art of crispy oven baked chicken cutlets. This easy, weeknight-friendly recipe delivers a golden, crunchy crust without any messy frying.

item.title: Creamy High Protein Mac and Cheese (With Cottage Cheese)
item.description: Get a creamy, comforting bowl of high protein mac and cheese with 38g of protein per serving. Fast, easy weeknight recipe using cottage cheese.

item.title: Easy Baked Chicken Thighs (Crispy Skin & Juicy Meat)
item.description: Learn how to make easy baked chicken thighs with perfectly crispy skin and juicy meat. Includes a reliable timing chart and a simple seasoning rub.

item.title: Sheet Pan One Pan Sausage and Peppers (Crispy & Roasted)
item.description: Make the ultimate one pan sausage and peppers on a sheet pan. Learn the exact roasting times, temperature settings, and serving ideas for a quick dinner.
